task.question: Who won the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale in July 2026?
task.evidence: July 16–19: 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale Golf Club in Southport, England – Ryan Fox

answer: Ryan Fox won the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale, held from July 16 to 19, 2026. He secured the victory by one stroke over Cameron Young, marking his first major championship title. FINAL: Ryan Fox.
